name: Gay It Loud
source:
It's 1995. Verity Bridges is back in her hometown after a year of unsuccessfully discovering herself. No money and no responsibilities: a perfect chance to throw her cares away at Eastbriar Mall.

In a retro shopping paradise filtered through thick, playful nostalgia goggles, find faces both old and new, master laser tag, and forge friendships and romances—all while running from the impending doom that is getting a job.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207560/Gay_It_Loud/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是1995年。维蒂·布里奇斯在经历了一年未能成功地发现自己之后回到了家乡。没有钱，没有责任：这是在Eastbriar购物中心抛开烦恼的绝佳机会。

在一个复古的购物天堂里，透过厚厚的、俏皮的怀旧护目镜，找到新老面孔，掌握激光标签，建立友谊和浪漫——同时逃离即将到来的找工作的厄运。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4207560/Gay_It_Loud/]Steam[/url]]
